title: Argus
description: Open-source AI security review agent written in Go. It runs real scanners (Semgrep, Gitleaks, OSV-Scanner) and reasons about their findings like an analyst would, or serves them over MCP as a toolbox for the AI you already use.

title: tsundoku
description: A single-owner library of what I have read, what I thought of it and what comes next, readable by Claude and ChatGPT over MCP. It also feeds the Shelf on this site.

title: kanpai
description: The same idea for wine and spirits: what I tasted, what is in the house and what is worth trying, for a sommelier that reads it over MCP.

title: bindex
description: A tracker for my Pokémon card collection: where it stands, which cards I want and which I don't, and what is still missing to complete the Pokédex.
